title: types crates: serde errors echo JSON Value via Display
description: Follow-up from JMAP-zegc review. Serde Deserialize impls interpolate a client-supplied serde_json::Value with Display: crate-jmap-chat-types/src/push.rs:282, crate-jmap-chat-types/src/ephemeral.rs:261 and :311, crate-jmap-types/src/push.rs:330, crate-jmap-scene-types/src/wire.rs:27,36, crate-jmap-vtc-types/src/wire.rs:27,36. Wherever a server forwards serde error text into an invalidArguments description, the value gets echoed (RFC 8620 §3.6.1). Fix: name only the JSON type (a json_type_name-style helper local to the types crates, since they do not depend on jmap-server). Check each site to confirm the value is client-controlled first.
close_reason: Batch 21 (run wf_18048230-8ff): implemented, adversarially verified; CI green except new cargo-deny advisory RUSTSEC-2026-0387 (crypto-bigint 0.5.5, unrelated to these changes) at 741292f0; beqc spec commits 639dc1d/7787c51 in jmap-chat-spec (not pushed)
